text: BaiLian Web 是面向 DSH 网页端的搜索与网页抓取后端插件。它向 DSH 的 web seam 注册搜索和抓取 provider，并通过 bundle 将其设为 web_search 与 web_fetch 的默认后端。搜索会返回网页链接、标题、摘要和日期等结果，抓取会返回网页文本内容与状态码。适合希望用阿里云百炼 MCP 服务为 DSH 提供联网搜索和网页读取能力的用户。需要配置 BAILIAN_API_KEY；请求发送到阿里云百炼 MCP 服务。

BaiLian Web connects DSH web search and fetching to Aliyun BaiLian MCP. It registers search and fetch providers as the web_search and web_fetch backends. Search returns page links and snippets; fetching returns page text and status. BAILIAN_API_KEY is required.
想让 DSH 用阿里云百炼来搜索网页和读取网页内容。
能把 DSH 的 web_search 和 web_fetch 后端换成百炼 MCP 吗？
I want DSH to search the web and fetch page text through Aliyun BaiLian.
BaiLian Web 的功能「百炼网页搜索」：通过 EnhancedSearch MCP 按查询词搜索，将链接、标题、摘要和发布时间转换为 DSH 搜索结果，供 web_search 调用。
BaiLian Web 的功能「百炼网页抓取」：通过 WebFetch MCP 获取指定 URL 内容，并转换为带目标 URL、状态码和文本正文的 DSH 抓取结果。
BaiLian Web 使用前须知：查询词或待抓取 URL 会发送至百炼 MCP，并使用 BAILIAN_API_KEY 鉴权（见 index.js:36-38、62-80、131-145）。

@local/bailian-web README · @local/bailian-web：Keeps the harness's model-facing `web_search` and `web_fetch` tools, but routes
them to Aliyun BaiLian's hosted MCP services instead of the shipped providers.

| Capability | MCP server | Upstream tool | Provider id |
|---|---|---|---|
| `web_search` | `EnhancedSearch` | `search_pro` | `bailian-search` |
| `web_fetch` | `WebFetch` | `web_fetch` | `bailian-fetch` |

@local/bailian-web README · Endpoints and credentials：Both endpoints are workspace-scoped BaiLian MCP gateways:

- `https://ws-u0ho7scff8sgmt4e.cn-beijing.maas.aliyuncs.com/api/v1/mcps/EnhancedSearch/mcp`
- `https://ws-u0ho7scff8sgmt4e.cn-beijing.maas.aliyuncs.com/api/v1/mcps/WebFetch/mcp`

@local/bailian-web README · Notes：- The gateway is stateless: each response is plain JSON (no `Mcp-Session-Id`),
  and a session id is forwarded if a future deployment starts issuing one.
- The handshake runs once per provider per process and is retried after a
  transport or session rejection.
- Search results are projected onto the seam's `WebSearchSource` shape from the
  upstream `pages[]` array; fetch results use `target_status_code` and
  `content`, and an unparseable body is returned as plain text.
- The provider stays registered even when the key is missing, so the tool
  reports a structured `WEB_PROVIDER_CREDENTIAL_MISSING` error instead of
  disappearing.
